exact.why: toCents and fromCents: inverse conversions that look alike (planted; not in the tree).
Tiny same-name functions with different bodies (planted).
v3's shorthand planting: a second vertical's taskCreated(origin, taskId, occurredAt) beside noteCreated must not form a class (its payload key differs).
v3's silent decoy: another vertical's constructor keyed by a different id (`id: taskId`) beside noteDeleted.
v3's owed same-file tag-only twin (N2, Dogfood #23): noteCreated and noteDeleted differ only in the event name.
